title: All Your Perfects
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: A married couple's relationship is breaking down under pressure. The story alternates between their early love and the strained present, asking whether what they had can be recovered.
readIf: you want a raw, emotional marriage story that moves between past and present.
skipIf: you want a happy-go-lucky romance, because this is sad and heavily focused on pain between partners.

pairings.reason: The most famous of the author’s heavier books, also about love that is painful and complicated.
A softer, more sentimental love story that also moves between past and present.
Another heartbreaking romance for readers who like a good cry.
